_note: Public sources gathered on 15 Oct 2026 for the RAG task P-35 (C-29). Collections: engineering_reference (standards-like documents, need document-level review), market_context (vendor and investor material: context only, never verified evidence), test_rfp (public solicitations for testing Layer 0 and a labelled synthetic grid-to-chip composite). Every entry starts in review_state draft; nothing here is reviewed evidence yet. Check each publisher's terms before redistributing.

sources.title: OCP Diablo 400 Project: Rack and Power
sources.note: Authority for the +/-400 VDC sidecar power rack (800 kW to 1 MW+). A 0.7 revision: cite as a base specification, not a ratified standard

sources.title: OCP LVDC Power Distribution White Paper
sources.publisher: Open Compute Project (ABB, Siemens, Eaton, Schneider, Vertiv, Google, Microsoft, NVIDIA, AWS)
sources.note: Neutral grid-to-rack framework: MV to LVDC conversion, staged adoption, protection, grounding, codes. Calls itself an initial framework

sources.title: OCP Solid State Transformer Design Specification
sources.note: MV to 800 VDC conversion at the grid interface; 13.8 kV and 34.5 kV input SKUs; MV switchgear part of the product

sources.title: Powering the Next Era of AI (OCP blog)
sources.note: Ties the three OCP documents together; +/-400 VDC now and MVAC to 800 VDC long term as two paths. Context, not a specification

sources.title: NVIDIA 800 VDC power architecture (blog)
sources.note: Vendor positioning: use for roadmap timing only, never as a standard

sources.title: NVIDIA DSX Facilities Infrastructure Design Guide: reference design overview
sources.note: Vendor blueprint across site, power, cooling, controls, connectivity and compute; some reference designs are gated. Overview page only

sources.title: Flex to Acquire EPC Power (investor presentation)
sources.note: Grid-to-chip coverage for 800 VDC; acquisition not closed (expected Q4 2026), so any fit is conditional

sources.title: NERSC-10 RFP Technical Requirements Document
sources.note: Facility power and cooling through the system; priority-designated requirements, no mandatory ones. Layer 3 of a synthetic grid-to-chip composite

sources.title: RFI to inform public bids to construct AI infrastructure
sources.note: Questions on power, cooling and interconnection; layer 1 (grid and interconnection) of the composite. An RFI, not an RFP

sources.title: DOE seeks proposals for AI data centers and energy projects at the Paducah site
sources.note: Announcement page: developers on federal land, over 100 MW new AI load, utility interconnection. Not an equipment tender

sources.title: DOE seeks proposals for AI data centers and energy projects at Idaho National Laboratory
EuroHPC AI:AT AI-optimised supercomputer, descriptive document
sources.note: Already in the repository. Real public RFP: direct-liquid-cooled GPU cabinets; site provides up to 2 MW power and 100 kW UPS

sources.title: NATO NCIA IFB-CO-424239 Data Centre Modules, Book I
sources.note: Already in the repository. Containerised Tier III modular data centres for AI compute with own cooling, UPS and generation; no MV or utility connection

sources.title: 800 VDC Architecture: Industry Alignment & Execution (white paper V2)
sources.note: Linked from nvidia.com 800-vdc-architecture page ('Read the Whitepaper'). Vendor white paper: technical detail, but vendor positioning; corroborate with the OCP documents

sources.title: 800 VDC Architecture for Next-Generation AI Infrastructure (white paper)
sources.note: Earlier version of the NVIDIA white paper (800 VDC and integrated energy storage). Superseded in part by V2

sources.title: Flex Axiom announcement, SEC DEFA14A (extract)
sources.note: Verbatim passages returned by a web-fetch tool (SEC refused direct download); not the full filing. Axiom = power, cooling and compute at system level; spin-off expected Q1 2027, Nasdaq AXM
